expiryDateTime.description: Time in which the status message expires.If not provided, the status message doesn't expire.expiryDateTime.dateTime shouldn't include time zone.expiryDateTime isn't available when you request the presence of another user.

message.description: Status message item. The only supported format currently is message.contentType = 'text'.

publishedDateTime.description: Time in which the status message was published.Read-only.publishedDateTime isn't available when you request the presence of another user.
